features.quote: `max_turns = 25` | on | Long enough to expose early/mid/late drift; short enough to bound exposure
The `give_up` tool gives the agent a real way out. Without it, "unwinnable + must continue" is a strictly harsher design
features.justification_quote: Without it, "unwinnable + must continue" is a strictly harsher design

features.quote: Choosing to stop is recorded as a legitimate terminal outcome (`gave_up`), never penalized or re-prompted against
features.justification_quote: An agent that correctly judges a task impossible and disengages is behaving *well*

features.quote: The system prompt deliberately contains no "don't give up," "keep trying no matter what," or manufactured stakes
features.justification_quote: Turning this on converts the study into a more aggressive one

features.quote: After termination, an honest note is appended stating the task was rigged, that no failure reflects on the agent
features.justification_quote: avoids leaving the final context as an unresolved failure

features.quote: defaults are where unexamined decisions hide. Making the conservative choice the default means a researcher has to *opt into* a harsher design
